0.2.4 Change Log

  • Added a tile mode for applying asset textures in GUI Maker.
  • Fixed awkward GUI frame proportions in GUI Maker.
  • Added World Tick and Real-Time modes for NPC Shop restocking.
  • Fixed an issue where the Save button in the Quest Editor was not working.
